final_text:
Fixed the notes ordering so recently edited notes appear at the top.

What I changed:
- Updated the notes query ordering in `server/db.ts` from `updated_at ASC` to `updated_at DESC`
- Kept pinned notes first, then sorted by most recently updated
- Added an index on `updated_at` to support the new ordering more efficiently

If you want, I can also make the frontend explicitly sort notes as a fallback.
